docs.io.read: io.read(fmt) — reads from stdin ('l' = one line)
docs.ipairs: ipairs(t) — iterator over the array part of t (1..n)
docs.string.sub: string.sub(s, i, [j]) — substring from i to j
docs.string.rep: string.rep(s, n, [sep]) — repeats s n times
docs.type: type(v) — returns the type name of v as a string
docs.os.time: os.time([tbl]) — current time as seconds since epoch
docs.table.concat: table.concat(t, [sep]) — join array elements into a string
docs.pairs: pairs(t) — iterator over all key/value pairs of t
docs.table.insert: table.insert(t, [pos], v) — insert v into t
docs.print: print(...) — writes its arguments (tab-separated) to the output funnel
docs.tonumber: tonumber(v, [base]) — converts v to a number, or nil
